about: Each key the lock admits to sign it writes its own ledger, and the lock is every one of them: an accept lands under the key that signed it, never under another's name.
The epoch is counted over every signer, so two keys never stamp one epoch for two batches they landed apart.
What the render, the take, the second head and every reader of the lock read is the lock whole; a line no admitted key covers is refused before it lands.
The lines that vouch a source are read through land/vouched.ts, the module the words of the store left: the lock a key writes is read the same way.

cases.name: the owner signs after a lane

red was: a lane key admitted at epoch 162 signed its first batch into the owner's ledger, and the render kept only lines by the owner: the batch landed and stood nowhere
